headline: Anthropic publishes a Claude-attributed subexponential #3-SAT algorithm claim with Lean materials
summary: Anthropic contributed a version-one preprint on October 27 describing a deterministic algorithm that counts satisfying assignments for fixed-width CNF formulas in subexponential time, including #3-SAT, and attributes the core algorithm to an internal Claude research model. Anthropic’s official repository includes the paper and a Lean 4 formalization. Its README reports a successful local Lean build and lists only Lean’s three standard axioms for the main declarations; the repository also says Lean checks the formal statement and proof, while a human must check whether the statement matches the paper. This activation did not run the build or independently assess the proof. The README says the result is asymptotic and does not establish practical SAT performance.
